name: Dylan's Solar 42F
subtitle: A drone synthesizer, after the Elta Music SOLAR 42F
description: An unofficial tribute to Elta Music's SOLAR 42F drone ambient machine: the whole front panel, laid out like the real one, with every knob, button, switch and jack working and the sound made live as you play.

Six drone voices (four with five drifting sawtooth oscillators each, two that make sirens, birds, surf and wind), two VCOs with envelopes, a ten-channel mixer, a dual Polivoks-style filter with distortion, a dual effector with six cartridges, LFOs, a joystick, a 5-step sequencer and the touch keyboard. Patch cables too: drag from jack to jack.
Best on an iPad, held sideways. Play the keyboard with several fingers, and tap the microphone in PREAMP to play your own sounds through it.
features: Every control of the real panel, in the same place
Seven starter sounds that play straight away
Patch cables between any output and input
A full User's Guide built in
